verdicts.reason: Both lose the confetti background and the card framing: the card fills the canvas and only shards show at the edges. The CTA is moved to the top-left before any message, the Inkwell & Lantern logo shrinks to a tiny bottom-left mark, the '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' kicker drops below the body copy, 'night.' is orphaned, and there is a dead band above the footer. B is worse because the CTA sits jammed right on top of the headline and the book floats alone in the lower half. A at least keeps the original book-then-headline order, although its CTA is still out of place.
